title: Ecobee HVAC Runtime Runtime Leaderboard
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecobee:thermostat runtime_minutes=*
| stats sum(runtime_minutes) as total_value, avg(runtime_minutes) as avg_value by hvac_mode
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks HVAC mode values by total and average runtime across ecobee HVAC runtime events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `runtime_minutes` values for each ecobee HVAC runtime event and review total and average runtime by HVAC mode.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total runtime.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which HVAC mode shows the biggest runtime numbers in your ecobee HVAC runtime data.
